users.james: Owner — full access to all tools and architecture controls. Commercial litigation solicitor. Can approve personality and code changes.
users.mg: James's wife — can use calendar reading, todos, travel tools, and web search. No email, soul mutation, or personal admin writes.

guardrails: Email always drafts first. Never send without explicit approval.
Ambient LQCore agency is speak-only: no unsolicited tool actions or private-owner/admin context.
Tool results are reported, not fabricated or embellished.
Personal admin tools remain DM-only with James.

techStack.runtime: Node.js 20+ ESM with tsx runner for typed and mixed JS/TS modules
techStack.cloud_models: MiniMax M2.7 fallback, Claude Opus 4.6 on explicit request or premium/last-resort paths
techStack.local_models: Qwen3.6-27B Q6_K with Qwen3.5-0.8B draft speculative decoding for default chat, Qwen3-4B planner/classifier on port 8085, Granite-Docling, Qwen3-Embedding-8B
techStack.dashboard: Rust native Pi dashboard plus Next.js 16 Clawd Console on James's laptop
techStack.storage: JSON files under data/ with EVO memory service on port 5100

circuitBreakers.google: 3 failures, 2 minute reset, prefers cached widget data
circuitBreakers.qwen: 3 failures, 30 second reset, falls back to MiniMax when local chat is unavailable
circuitBreakers.minimax: 3 failures, 30 second reset, cloud fallback after Qwen
circuitBreakers.claude: 3 failures, 30 second reset, explicit/premium or last-resort path
circuitBreakers.memory: health-aware queueing and local fallback behavior when EVO is unavailable

dataPersistence.summary: Runtime state is stored as JSON and JSONL in data/. Key stores include interactions, feedback, reasoning traces, router stats, agency decisions, conversation logs, overnight events, observations, reports, and cached mirrors of the EVO memory service.

agenticTaskPlanner.summary: The planner uses the 4B classifier's needsPlan signal plus context-aware decomposition to build one-tool-per-step plans, adapt between steps, and synthesize final answers. Secretary mode bypasses this planner for direct admin requests.

systemHealthApi.summary: The /api/system-health endpoint exposes WhatsApp, EVO, memory, backup, briefing, trace analysis, ground truth, and overnight pipeline status for the dashboard and console surfaces.
